description: Closes the open project and RELEASES the lock (Gd3: use this, not tia_disconnect, to release the project). KEEPS the TIA process alive (response `portalKept`/`pid`) — the next tia_connect reuses it instead of paying the 40-80s cold start. A project with unsaved changes is never closed silently: the call is REFUSED with 409 `unsaved_changes` (nothing is changed) unless it carries `saveUnsavedChanges:true` (saves it, then closes; recommended, or call tia_project_save first) or `discardUnsavedChanges:true` (closes WITHOUT saving: DATA LOSS, only on an explicit human decision, never to get past the refusal; the client asks the human to confirm first). The response lists `savedProjects`/`discardedProjects`. Maps to POST /project/close. Long operation: may answer status:"running" + jobId — then call tia_job_status.

discardUnsavedChanges.description: DATA LOSS: close the modified project(s) WITHOUT saving; every unsaved change is lost for good. Only when a human explicitly decided to throw that work away, NEVER to get past an unsaved_changes refusal. Never together with saveUnsavedChanges.

saveUnsavedChanges.description: RECOMMENDED choice when a modified project would be closed: save every modified project this call closes, then close it. Without a flag such a call is refused with unsaved_changes and nothing is changed. Never together with discardUnsavedChanges.

name: tia_project_close
title: TIA — close project
